summary: Tested Günlük Mod (Daily Mood) module — backend (7 endpoints) and frontend UI. Backend: all 6 pytest cases PASS covering config GET/PUT, today/once-per-day entry, my-history, and CRITICAL privacy report (verified no employee_id/name/persons keys and no PII in aggregate response with recursive scanner). Frontend: verified via code review + partial UI — MoodSettings is a single settings form (no list/create UI, no question-pool editor, no anonymity toggle, fixed Emoji 1-5 note present). MoodReport shows today_avg/avg7/trend + dept filter and NO table/persons rendering. MoodPage shows mood-done confirmation when entry exists, includes own 7-day trend, discovery card 'Günlük Mod' present on /ic-iletisim. Reminder banner logic gates correctly by time (17:00 UTC, current server hour was 12:59 UTC → banner correctly hidden). Could not fully drive admin & employee-switch flows through Radix DropdownMenu radio items via Playwright (menu closes before onValueChange fires); code review of Shell.js / AppContext.js confirms wiring is correct.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1030 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into modules (mood.py, pulse.py, events.py) in a future refactor. Not blocking.
MoodReport.js correctly excludes any persons/employee arrays; MoodPage own-trend uses /mood/my-history scoped to employee_id — privacy contract enforced end-to-end.

seed_mood_if_empty stores gunluk_mod as a category doc with extra fields (allow_comment/reminder_enabled/reminder_time). This mixes schema — acceptable since it's a singleton, but tag with CategoryTypes doc if extended.

success_rate.frontend: partial — direct-observable elements verified; role/emp switcher via Radix radio not drivable headlessly

seed_data_creation: Backend test created one mood entry for Buse Demir (TEST_mood comment) as part of once-per-day verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Radix DropdownMenu radio-item clicks (role-option-admin, emp-option-*) do not reliably fire onValueChange when driven via Playwright page.click even after opening the trigger. To drive admin/emp flows, either (a) add temporary querystring role override, (b) persist role/currentEmployeeId in localStorage so tests can set it directly, or (c) use keyboard.press('ArrowDown')+'Enter' on the open menu. All backend privacy assertions pass — see /app/backend/tests/test_mood.py for regression.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Testing-tool limitation only, not a product defect.
